sources.cldr: Unicode CLDR 46.0 territoryInfo (language % of population, L1+L2)
sources.wikipedia: English Wikipedia speaker tables (L1+L2), pinned revisions: List of countries by English-speaking population rev 1379399265; Geographical distribution of French speakers rev 1379390459; Geographical distribution of German speakers rev 1379876187; Geographical distribution of Russian speakers rev 1374595124; Portuguese-speaking world rev 1380645261

method: speakers = population(year) x share(year). share is the larger of the CLDR value and the Wikipedia L1+L2 table value, held constant, or interpolated from census anchors where listed. Population after 2024 is projected from each country's growth over the previous five years.
